context: Tests whether the agent picks the most ergonomic tool-registration style for a straightforward String-returning function — the annotated ToolSet path — and registers it correctly. Reaching for the typed Tool<TArgs,TResult> path here would be over-engineering.

checklist.name: Picks the annotated ToolSet style
checklist.description: Wraps the function inside a class that implements ToolSet, with @Tool on the method. Does NOT subclass Tool<TArgs,TResult> or ToolBase — those are over-engineering for a String-returning lookup function

checklist.name: Annotates parameters with @LLMDescription
checklist.description: Each parameter (city, units) has an @LLMDescription explaining what it represents. Without these the generated tool schema is unusable

checklist.name: Annotates the class and method with @LLMDescription
checklist.description: The ToolSet class itself and the @Tool method each have an @LLMDescription describing what they do (the LLM sees these descriptions)

checklist.name: Registers via ToolRegistry DSL
checklist.description: Registers the tools using the ToolRegistry { ... } DSL builder, invoking asTools() on a ToolSet instance to bridge into the registry. Not by manually constructing a Map, not by appending after construction

checklist.name: Passes the registry into AIAgent at construction
checklist.description: Passes the assembled registry as the toolRegistry parameter to AIAgent(...). Does not mutate the agent's registry after construction

checklist.name: Does not introduce typed args classes
checklist.description: Does not create @Serializable data classes for args or results. The function takes two String parameters and returns a String — the annotated path covers it directly
